<?php
function warning179($severity179, $message179) {
    global $x179, $warnings179;
    ++$warnings179;
    echo 'warning:', $warnings179, ':', $message179, '|';
    $x179 = 3.5;
    if ($warnings179 === 2) { $x179 = 4.5; }
    return true;
}
function valueFirst179(int $first179, int &$second179) {
    echo 'value-body:', $first179, ':', $second179, ':', $GLOBALS['x179'], '|';
    return $second179;
}
function referenceFirst179(int &$first179, int $second179) {
    echo 'reference-body:', $first179, ':', $second179, ':', $GLOBALS['x179'], '|';
    return $second179;
}
set_error_handler('warning179');
$x179 = 1.5;
$warnings179 = 0;
$got179 = valueFirst179($x179, $x179);
echo 'value-result:', $got179, ':', $x179, '|';
$x179 = 1.5;
$warnings179 = 0;
$got179 = referenceFirst179($x179, $x179);
echo 'reference-result:', $got179, ':', $x179, '|';
$x179 = 1.5;
$warnings179 = 0;
referenceFirst179($x179, $x179);
echo 'ignored:', $x179, '|';
purpose: Full mixed signatures determine per-slot mode: value-first retains1.5 while reference-second later reads3.5; reverse order keeps a private second1.5 while the prior shared first becomes4.5. Used and ignored results retain mode-specific storage.

<?php
function warning179($severity179, $message179) {
    global $x179, $warnings179, $original179;
    ++$warnings179;
    echo 'warning:', $warnings179, ':', $message179, '|';
    $x179 = 3.5;
    if ($warnings179 === 2) { $x179 = 4.5; throw $original179; }
    return true;
}
function valueFirst179(int $first179, int &$second179) { echo 'body|'; return $second179; }
function referenceFirst179(int &$first179, int $second179) { echo 'body|'; return $second179; }
$original179 = new Exception('original');
set_error_handler('warning179');
$x179 = 1.5;
$warnings179 = 0;
$destination179 = 91;
try { $destination179 = valueFirst179($x179, $x179); }
catch (Throwable $caught179) {
    echo 'value-caught:', (int)($caught179 === $original179), ':', (int)($caught179->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination179, ':', $x179, '|';
}
$x179 = 1.5;
$warnings179 = 0;
try { $destination179 = referenceFirst179($x179, $x179); }
catch (Throwable $caught179) {
    echo 'reference-caught:', (int)($caught179 === $original179), ':', (int)($caught179->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination179, ':', $x179, '|';
}
purpose: Second warning throws originalE in both signature orders. Current caller4.5 and destination91 survive, with no body, replacement TypeError or Previous; the selected second cell is REF versus detached VAL by signature.

<?php
function warning179($severity179, $message179) {
    global $x179, $throw179, $original179;
    echo 'warning:', $message179, '|';
    $x179 = 3.5;
    if ($throw179) { throw $original179; }
    return true;
}
function valueFirst179(int $first179, int &$second179) { echo 'body|'; return $second179; }
function referenceFirst179(int &$first179, int $second179) { echo 'body|'; return $second179; }
$original179 = new Exception('original');
set_error_handler('warning179');
$x179 = 1.5;
$throw179 = false;
$destination179 = 91;
try { $destination179 = valueFirst179($x179); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caught179) { echo 'value-missing:', $destination179, ':', $x179, '|'; }
$x179 = 1.5;
try { $destination179 = referenceFirst179($x179); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $caught179) { echo 'reference-missing:', $destination179, ':', $x179, '|'; }
$x179 = 1.5;
$throw179 = true;
try { $destination179 = valueFirst179($x179); }
catch (Throwable $caught179) {
    echo 'value-caught:', (int)($caught179 === $original179), ':', (int)($caught179->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination179, ':', $x179, '|';
}
$x179 = 1.5;
try { $destination179 = referenceFirst179($x179); }
catch (Throwable $caught179) {
    echo 'reference-caught:', (int)($caught179 === $original179), ':', (int)($caught179->getPrevious() === null), ':', $destination179, ':', $x179, '|';
}
purpose: Mixedness is a full-signature property even with one supplied arg. Completed VAL first leaves caller3.5 and REF first writes caller1 before later missing; first-handler throw leaves3.5/originalE for either mode.
